purpose: Form study showing 4 organic pebble-like form variants for elderly AI companion device
prompt:
Industrial design form study sheet showing 4 organic form variants for an elderly AI companion device, arranged side by side on a warm cream background (#F5F0E8).

All four variants share these traits: completely rounded with no sharp edges (minimum 8mm radius on every edge), non-animal, non-human, palm-sized (120-150mm diameter), desktop companion device aesthetic. Each is a smooth pebble-like form wrapped in cream fabric (#F5F0E8) with a light oak wood base ring (#C4A882) at the bottom.

Variant 1 (leftmost): Classic pebble shape — slightly asymmetric oval, height-to-width ratio 1.3:1. Subtle amber glow ring (#E8B87A) at the fabric-wood junction in the upper area.

Variant 2: Taller pebble — height-to-width ratio 1.5:1, more elongated, like a smooth river stone standing upright. Gentle taper from wider base to narrower top.

Variant 3: Wider, flatter pebble — height-to-width ratio 1.2:1, more squat and stable looking, like a stone resting flat. Warm gray (#D4CFC7) soft-touch button on front face.

Variant 4: Rounded cylinder with domed top — slightly more geometric but still fully organic, like a smooth capsule shape. The most "designed" of the four while maintaining warmth.

Each variant shown as a clean 3/4 perspective view on a subtle warm shadow. No text overlays, no annotations — pure form exploration. Warm 2700K lighting, soft shadows in warm tone (#8A8279). Photorealistic product rendering quality, like a premium industrial design portfolio piece.
